en: Black-and-white panoramic view over a historic European city with dense low rooftops in the foreground and a large Romanesque cathedral with four tall square towers and spires prominently visible on the right side. At the bottom left the caption "Pécs" appears, and at the bottom right the word "Látkép" (Hungarian for 'view'). The reverse side shows a divided-back postcard layout with Hungarian handwriting, a green Hungarian postage stamp, and the printer's mark "Barasits Budapest".
